_meta.method: Rendered-size measurement at 360/390/768/1280/1440/1900 across all 31 pages (tools/w9r2-measure.mjs → .w9/rendered-sizes.json); provenance traced against the 4DK application repository (Applications/4DK MAIN: git history, web/public/reference, web/public/food), the 4DK Food Library 0.7.0 export (35 images, 34 RIGHTS_VERIFIED CC/PD/CC0 with per-asset creator+license+source), the app database media_assets table, all 14 approved-artifact resource pools, and the Stage14 zip.
rules: Stage14 PRODUCTION_INTEGRATION.md: hero photography ~2x largest rendered dimension; preview images are placeholders/source references, not permission to ship blurry media; do not upscale; canonical acid banner is literal, never recreated approximately.
W9-R2: prototype inclusion does not by itself prove production rights; no upscaling as closure; no unknown-rights standalone imagery; honest BLOCKED allowed.
_meta.resolution_status_meaning: SUFFICIENT = source ≥ rendered size at every width (no browser upscaling; 2x is the quality target for hero roles). REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED = source is stretched below 1x at some rendered width.
_meta.design_corpus_note: The approved artifacts' food photography (hero, jollof set, cards, strips, note/rail art) and the app's pantry design boards (web/public/reference/pantry-ingredient-source{,-2}.png) form one owner-supplied design corpus with NO recorded per-photo source, creator, or license anywhere in the project. Pixel-correlation against all 34 library-licensed images: no match (all ≈0).
_meta.licensed_fallback_available: 4DK Food Library 0.7.0 (Applications/4DK MAIN/food-library/exports/current): 34 RIGHTS_VERIFIED photographs (CC-BY-SA-4.0 x25, CC0 x3, public-domain x1, CC-BY-SA-2.0 x2, CC-BY-SA-3.0 x1, CC-BY-3.0 x1, CC-BY-4.0 x1), 752-1920px, incl. Jollof rice 1920x1440 CC-BY-SA-4.0 by Ei'eke. NOT exposed in any shipped asset (verified by code path + pixel correlation). Adoption for any marketing surface is an owner visual-parity + attribution decision.
